info.title: CCM Manager API
info.description: This API is used to manage the CCM Manager, which is a tool that comunicates between the UI STD DLT and the Orchestrator

get.description: Fetches and returns active deployment identifiers directly from the remote SDT orchestrator.

200.description: List of SDT UUIDs successfully fetched.

502.description: Failed to fetch from SDT deployment service proxy due to unreachable host.

get.description: Fetches all stored certificates from the collection.
Fetches a specific certificate by its certification_id.

parameters.name: cert_uuid
parameters.description: The exact UUID of the target certificate.

post.description: Receives a compact certificate evaluation result for an already generated certificate, applies the CCM certificate state machine, uploads the updated certificate to the DLT, and stores the new certificate ledger hash. Initial certificate issuance remains handled by POST /assessment-result.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Evaluation result for a ToE and certification scheme.

evidence_id.description: Optional evidence identifier stored in the last_evaluation metadata.

200.description: Certificate state updated and uploaded to DLT.

404.description: ToE, certification scheme, or active certificate not found.

409.description: Evaluation result is invalid for the current certificate state.

put.description: Locates a certificate, explicitly enforces its decision_status to 'Withdrawn', and logs the state change transaction permanently within its history array.

parameters.name: cert_uuid
parameters.description: The exact UUID of the target certificate to withdraw.

200.description: Certificate state changed to withdrawn successfully.

404.description: Configured Certificate not properly mapped or invalid.

post.description: Scans a provided folder for known dependency files and generates a corresponding SBOM. Saves SBOM and associated VEX data.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: The full path to the folder containing the project with a dependency file (e.g., `requirements.txt`, `package.json`, or `pom.xml`).

200.description: SBOM generated and project created successfully.

message.example: SBOM generated, project created, and vulnerabilities saved successfully

400.description: Invalid input or missing dependency file.

error.example: No recognized dependency file found in the provided folder or subdirectories.

get.description: Fetches all stored vulnerabilities from the MongoDB collection.

post.description: Generates three Cryptographic BOMs (Algorithms, Certificates, and Protocols) from a JSON file input containing cipher and/or certificate data. Optionally associates with a hashed IP address.

parameters.name: hashed_ip
parameters.description: Optional hashed IP address to associate the generated SBOM with a client.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: A JSON file containing cipher and/or certificate data.

400.description: Bad request (e.g. file missing, invalid JSON, or insufficient data).

error.example: No file part in the request.

post.summary: Receive Output and Trigger CBOM Generation
post.description: Receives either a JSON file upload or raw JSON data from a client, hashes the client IP, and forwards the input to the `/generate_cbom` endpoint to generate CBOMs.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Optional .json file to process and generate CBOM.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Optional JSON body string to process if file is not provided. Send as a stringified JSON.

400.description: Invalid input provided (no file or invalid JSON).

post.description: Uploads an OSCAL document (component-definition, catalog, or profile). Accepts either raw JSON or a file upload.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Optional OSCAL JSON file to upload.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Optional raw JSON body string if not using a file.

200.description: OSCAL document successfully saved or already exists.

400.description: Invalid input or missing required fields.

error.example: No JSON data or file provided.

get.summary: Get OSCAL Control IDs by Document UUID
get.description: Retrieves a list of unique control IDs from an OSCAL profile document by its UUID.

parameters.name: doc_uuid
parameters.description: UUID of the OSCAL document

200.description: List of control IDs retrieved successfully.

404.description: Profile not found for the provided UUID.

get.description: Retrieves all Target of Evaluation (ToE) documents from the database across dedicated and fallback collections.

200.description: List of all ToEs retrieved successfully.

post.description: Validates and uploads a CycloneDX-formatted SaaSBOM JSON document into the database.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: CycloneDX SaaSBOM JSON

400.description: Validation error due to missing or invalid fields.

post.description: Receives a TOE descriptor, validates core fields, and forwards the payload to a remote URL.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: TOE Descriptor JSON containing 'component', and optionally 'bills-of-material', 'mud', and 'threat-mud'

get.description: Fetches all stored certification schemes from the collection.
Fetches a specific scheme by its ID.

parameters.name: scheme_id
parameters.description: The ID of the target certification scheme.

delete.description: Deletes a specific scheme by its ID from the database.

parameters.name: scheme_id
parameters.description: The ID of the target certification scheme to delete.

post.description: Uploads a certification scheme document along with optional profile and catalog data. Updates existing entry if UUID matches. Fully compliant with the Compliance Metrics Model.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Certification Scheme data with optional catalog and profile

productProfile.description: Retained from original scheme for compatibility

200.description: Certification Scheme saved or updated successfully.

message.example: Certification Scheme and related documents updated successfully.

400.description: Missing or invalid certification scheme data.

error.example: Missing required fields in Certification Scheme

post.description: Stores a component-definition from an OSCAL JSON document as a CCM ledger entry. Wraps the entry with UUID, timestamp, and hash.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: OSCAL JSON document containing a component-definition

put.description: Updates an existing ledger entry identified by UUID with new OSCAL component-definition data and updates the hash and timestamp.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the ledger entry to update

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: OSCAL JSON document containing the updated component-definition

post.description: Receives a CycloneDX Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) in JSON format, validates it, and forwards it to another service.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: CycloneDX SBOM JSON document

200.description: CycloneDX SBOM received and forwarded successfully.

status.example: CycloneDX SBOM received and forwarded successfully

400.description: Bad request. Missing or invalid parameters.

get.description: Fetches all stored metrics from the metrics collection.

post.description: Accepts a single metric object or an array of metric objects to upload or update.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: A single metric or a JSON array of metrics.

400.description: Invalid input format or empty data.

get.description: Fetches a specific metric by its 'id' field.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the metric

get.description: Fetches all stored risks from the risks collection.

post.description: Accepts a single risk object or an array of risk objects to upload or update. Uses 'risk_id' as key.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: A single risk or a JSON array of risks.

400.description: Invalid input format or empty data.

get.description: Fetches a specific risk by its 'risk_id' field.

parameters.name: risk_id
parameters.description: The ID of the risk

get.description: Fetches all stored threats from the threats collection.

post.description: Accepts a single threat object or an array of threat objects to upload or update. Uses 'threat_id' as key.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: A single threat or a JSON array of threats.

400.description: Invalid input format or empty data.

get.description: Fetches a specific threat by its 'threat_id' field.

parameters.name: threat_id
parameters.description: The ID of the threat

get.description: Fetches all stored controls from the controls collection.

post.description: Accepts a single control object or an array of control objects to upload or update. Uses 'control_id' as key.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: A single control or a JSON array of controls.

400.description: Invalid input format or empty data.

get.description: Fetches a specific control by its 'control_id' field.

parameters.name: control_id
parameters.description: The ID of the control

get.description: Stop the SDT manager process. Note: This endpoint has a 10 second internal delay.

post.description: Full workflow chain: parse BOM file, POST to ledger, GET hash, and call send_sdt. Supports JSON and XML BOM files.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Chain trigger parameters

bom_path.description: Full path to the BOM file (JSON or XML)

unique_key.description: Unique key for the blockchain record

400.description: Missing required parameters or unsupported file format

500.description: Failed to communicate with blockchain or SDT services

post.description: Trigger deletion of a resource in the external SDT system.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Delete request parameters

identifier.description: Unique identifier of the resource to delete

500.description: DELETE_SDT not configured or external service error
